{{Quote|Hastily squashed rumor has it that the Sulfur Lake Pirates captured a particularly repulsive creature native to Lok and have taken to referring to it as 'Nym's Girlfriend'!|[[Grenz Zittoun]]|<ref name="SWG:EB" />}}
'''Nym's Girlfriend''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[pharple]] native to the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was named after the leader of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] by a rival group, the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]]. The beast was captured and tamed by the Sulfur Lake Pirates after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and kept in their [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] on Lok. The pirates named the flightless [[Bird/Legends|bird]] after the leader of their enemies as a means by which to humiliate him. As such, an underling of Nym's named [[Grenz Zittoun]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the embarrassing creature.<ref name="SWG:EB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Lok Revenants raided the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout in order to retrieve the [[memory module]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> During the assault, a spacer attacked and killed the pharple so that it could no longer serve as a derisive symbol.<ref name="SWG:EB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nym's Girlfriend appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nym's Girlfriend was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:EB" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
